name: company-scrapper-service
description: Always-on API for the Researchers/Company Scrapper AI — reads/writes the live Prisma Postgres business store and exposes trade-area search and a live chatbot. Understanding free-text chat messages is handled by OUR OWN fine-tuned worker model (workers/researchers-company-scrapper-chat/, stacked on the project's template adapter), never a third-party LLM, with a deterministic regex parser as an automatic fallback whenever that model is unavailable. Real geocoding + real fuzzy category matching + the actual database queries are always deterministic either way.
